name: DuckBot Complete Control
description: Complete DuckBot ecosystem control - AI, services, cost tracking, RAG, VibeVoice TTS, Qwen analysis, and system management

function.name: duckbot_execute_command
function.description: Universal DuckBot command interface - execute ANY DuckBot operation including ecosystem control, AI chat, service management, cost tracking, RAG knowledge base, VibeVoice TTS, Qwen code analysis, and system diagnostics

message.description: Message for AI chat, task prompts, or code analysis

task_type.description: Type of AI task to execute

days.description: Number of days for cost summary and analytics

query.description: Search query for RAG knowledge base

top_k.description: Number of search results to return

model_id.description: AI model identifier for model management

paths.description: Semicolon-separated paths for RAG document ingestion

code.description: Code to analyze with Qwen system

mode.description: Ecosystem startup mode or bot operation mode

diagnostic_type.description: Type of system diagnostic to run

author: DuckBot Integration Team

parameters.message: Explain quantum computing in simple terms

parameters.code: def fibonacci(n): return n if n <= 1 else fibonacci(n-1) + fibonacci(n-2)

installation: 1. Ensure DuckBot ecosystem is running (START_ECOSYSTEM.bat or python start_ecosystem.py)
2. Import this JSON file into OpenWebUI Functions/Tools section
3. The tool will auto-detect DuckBot server and authenticate automatically
usage_examples: @duckbot_execute_command('rag_search', 'machine learning best practices') - Search knowledge base
@duckbot_execute_command('qwen_analyze', 'def fibonacci(n): return n if n <= 1 else fibonacci(n-1) + fibonacci(n-2)') - Analyze code
troubleshooting: If authentication fails: Ensure DuckBot WebUI is running at localhost:8787
If commands timeout: Check DuckBot system resources and logs
If services fail to start: Use emergency_kill command first, then restart
If batch commands fail: Ensure you're running on Windows with proper permissions
